lore.origin: Spawn shed by Aetherial Beasts and thin-veil ruptures; vermin of the magical wild.
lore.description: Palm-sized crawling rainbows that bite with static teeth.
lore.weaknesses: Salt circle; dies in 1 round if separated from Ether source farther than 100 ft.

traits.name: Swarm Bite
traits.text: For each additional larva in same space attacking same target, +1 damage on hit.

treasure: Larva dust (1 spell amp, 5 gp per vial)
